title: Feeding while attached
hook: Some animals gather food without moving from a surface.

knows: Some animals can remain attached to a surface.
doesNotKnow: Identify the feeding appendages in a schematic acorn barnacle.

misconception: An attached animal must be a plant or cannot gather food.
objective: Identify the feeding appendages in a schematic acorn barnacle.

claims.text: Some animals gather food without moving from a surface. In the illustrated acorn barnacle, what sweeps through water to help collect food particles? The schematic shows an attached acorn barnacle extending feathery appendages called cirri into the water. They help collect suspended food particles. The figure simplifies the timing and motion of feeding.

claims.text: The stage uses a simplified, not-to-scale schematic and stated model assumptions; it is not a photographic observation of an individual animal.
